About us About us Advisory board Careers Contact Construction’s first AI-powered research hub Get the insights LAB Home Who we are Resources Sign in Get a demo Hello, we’re construction’s first AI-powered research hub . WHO WE ARE Buildots Intelligence Lab. Construction is one of the world’s largest industries, yet one of the last to become data-driven. For too long, it has relied on gut feeling and static benchmarks that are often out of date and based on low-fidelity data. We’re here to help modernize the field, giving leaders reliable data to guide decision-making from the project to the enterprise, and answer questions like: How much MEP work can realistically be delivered in a week? How well is this project performing in comparison to industry benchmarks? How do I evaluate trade productivity? While we publish objective data, we don’t claim to have all the answers. We believe data is a dialogue, and we often lean on our global ‘hive mind’ to help interpret complex findings. Get in touch Our intelligence pillars . Insights We look for ‘nuggets’ of information that create genuine ‘aha’ moments – the kind of information that informs real-world changes that optimize construction performance. Metrics By standardizing metrics for measuring performance, we move past subjective percentages and gut feelings, giving you a clear way to track everything from scheduling to output to efficiency and beyond. Benchmarks True progress requires a point of comparison. Our benchmarks allow you to see exactly where you stand against the global industry standard, whether categorized by sector, region, or specific trade. Team The people powering the Lab. Amir Berman VP Industry Transformation Andy Steele Lab advisor & former GC CEO David Milnes Industry Transformation Manager & former GC Head of Digital Construction Dima Zabezhinsky Industry Transformation Manager WE WANT TO HEAR FROM YOU Let's turn your intuition into intelligence, together. If there's something you've always wondered about construction productivity, a pattern you've spotted anecdotally but never been able to prove, or a hunch you'd like to back up with hard data, we want to know. Whether you’re a construction professional, academic, consultant, or other researcher, send us your questions, and we'll dive into the data. Get in touch Frequently asked questions What is the Buildots Intelligence Lab? The Buildots Intelligence Lab is construction’s first AI-powered research hub, established to transform intuition-based decision-making into objective construction intelligence. The Lab’s work is built on three central pillars: insights to identify critical trends, metrics that establish standards by which to measure performance and benchmarks to provide a global point of comparison across verticals, trades and geographies. Led by a team of elite researchers and construction industry professionals, it functions as a collaborative research environment where professionals can challenge the Lab to validate on-site patterns with statistical proof. Where does the Buildots Intelligence Lab get its data? Our aggregated, anonymized data comes from global construction projects. When we publish an insight, we typically indicate the region and location of projects included in the analysis. Is the Buildots Intelligence Lab part of Buildots? We are. However, the Lab operates as an autonomous research unit dedicated to industry transformation rather than commercial activities. This distinction is vital. It ensures our insights remain objective, transparent, and focused on providing the construction industry with an unbiased source of truth. Can I talk to someone from the Lab? Of course. We’re always keen to hear from construction industry pros, academics, researchers and media. Get in touch with us via the contact page. Are you open to partnerships with industry and academia? Absolutely. We believe that modernizing construction is a collective effort. The Lab actively seeks to partner with universities, consultancies, and industry bodies. If you have a research initiative or a complex industry challenge you’d like to explore together, get in touch with us via the contact page.
